discussion:
Imported from role task file `tasks/section_18/section_18.4.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2019-CIS` and Audit control `section_18/section_18.4/cis_18.4.1.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2019-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

Applies to: Member Server only (from the upstream task name).

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "18.4.1 | PATCH | Ensure Apply UAC restrictions to local accounts on network logons is set to Enabled MS only | Member Server"
  when:
    - win19cis_rule_18_4_1
    - prelim_win19cis_is_domain_member
  tags:
    - level1-memberserver
    - rule_18.4.1
    - patch
    - uac
    - NIST800-171_3.1.1
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-2_9
  ansible.windows.win_regedit:
    path: HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System
    name: LocalAccountTokenFilterPolicy
    data: 0
    type: dword
